findings.issue: Raw generation accepts a filename that shared ledger readers cannot discover.
findings.disposition: Fixed: raw generation requires canonical ledger filename; intentional computed export remains separate.

findings.issue: A final read could reopen a different physical ledger after resolving its home.
findings.disposition: Fixed: retain an independent directory reference through final admission; a correlated replacement test verifies binding.

findings.issue: New private journal ancestors are not synchronized before public publication writes.
findings.disposition: Fixed: synchronize new private directory ancestry before pending/public writes; real ordering traces and injected failures verified.

findings.issue: Incomplete discovery may conceal another matching ledger during implicit selection or first publication.
findings.disposition: Fixed: incomplete enumeration cannot establish implicit uniqueness or first-publication absence; partial listing and explicit-home access remain usable.

findings.issue: Existing movement tests do not detect transaction replacements writing into an unrelated former home.
findings.disposition: Fixed: full transaction movement/commit/reopened-recovery oracle kills former-path rename mutation.

findings.issue: A database-error test accepts an unrelated ticket-ID diagnostic as success.
findings.disposition: Fixed: source/type negative cases require their intended actionable diagnostics; unrelated identity diagnostic mutant is rejected.

findings.issue: Backfill and migration bypass shared selection safeguards for incomplete scans and explicit unenumerated homes.
findings.disposition: Fixed: maintenance consumers share selection guards and propagate explicit home into nested migration; complete valid absence remains a no-op.

findings.issue: The trusted base workflow omitted the new roadmap flag required by the candidate Pages builder.
findings.disposition: Fixed: explicit Pages roadmap_path config supplies normal input; CLI override and containment remain enforced.

findings.issue: Pending ledger read failures are excluded from implicit uniqueness and first-publication absence decisions.
findings.disposition: Fixed: operational read uncertainty blocks implicit uniqueness and first-publication absence; explicit healthy selection and invalid-ledger exclusion remain supported.

findings.issue: Artifact publication drops physical selection before write admission and accepts a distinct same-ticket replacement.
findings.disposition: Fixed: retain the selected directory descriptor through physical write admission before recovery can touch a replacement.

findings.issue: Discovery accepts an in-root alias target at traversal depth while explicit selection/publication measure physical depth.
findings.disposition: Fixed: discovery and explicit selection use physical depth per configured root, preserving independently configured union coverage.

findings.issue: Optional publication project inferred ownership from the ledger destination, retaining old callers and risking unrelated configuration for external roots.
findings.disposition: Fixed following the user compatibility question: require a nonblank owning project and pass it explicitly through snapshot, relocation, formatting and test callers.

findings.issue: Parallel anomaly CLI subtests rewrite shared YAML configuration while sibling CLI readers open it, intermittently producing EOF or a fixture panic.
findings.disposition: Fixed: prepare shared configuration before each subtest calls t.Parallel; CLI execution and all assertions remain parallel and unchanged. The pre-fix repeated race run failed; 30 corrected repetitions passed.
